# Exit argument-allocation diagnosis

Scratch-only causal comparison of the two certified private set-argument allocation
assumptions emitted at RemoveFactor's fallthrough exit. The native control emits
every original command. The diagnostic traverses the same complete preparation
and fuel path, then omits exactly those two assumptions; every assignment,
can-call fact, actual check, summary, procedure contract and transfer remains.
A genuine false-entry control checks nonvacuity. Full check-expression and
attribute fingerprints must match the native control. This deliberate support
omission is excluded as a product fix. Keep sources, solver, limits and batches
unchanged. Selected names bound only this causal experiment.
